audio_source.description: PipeWire source for cava. Empty follows what you hear (default output monitor)
audio_source.label: Audio source

bands.description: Number of spectrum bars, and of wallpaper columns sampled behind them
bands.label: Bands

brightness.description: How far each bar is lifted toward white so it reads on a dark wallpaper
brightness.label: Brightness lift

color_mode.description: Which wallpaper pixel a bar takes its colour from
color_mode.label: Colour sampling

options.tip: At the bar's tip (moves with the music)

fps.description: cava frame rate; 60 is smooth, 30 halves the CPU cost
fps.label: Frame rate

height.description: Widget height in px - match the desktop widget box
height.label: Canvas height

min_light.description: Minimum lightness of a bar, so dark wallpaper regions still show
min_light.label: Minimum lightness

monitor.description: Output connector this widget sits on (e.g. eDP-1). Empty = match the wallpaper grid by canvas size
monitor.label: Monitor

smoothing.description: Bar attack/release in ms. Higher is softer, 0 is raw cava
smoothing.label: Smoothing

wallpaper.description: Leave empty to follow the shell's current wallpaper
wallpaper.label: Wallpaper image

width.description: Widget width in px - match the desktop widget box
width.label: Canvas width
